guide: Open Start and type your business name, your fees (extra mile, late return, cleaning, refill, toll admin) and your chase days in the yellow cells.
Keep Vehicles and Vehicle Classes up to date: the class, fuel type, deposit and miles included each day (miles are the demo unit, set your own).
At every pickup and return write one row in Check-out and Check-in: handing the car over and taking it back, with time, odometer, level, photos yes or no and keys.
Read the fee columns of that row: extra miles, late minutes after the grace, refill steps and cleaning give the fee due.
Copy each fee into Fee Log, mark it billed or not, and write what you collected; Fee Ageing and Money Left on the Table fill in by themselves.
Use Return Fee Calculator at the counter and Handover Completeness Check before a car leaves.
Record each damage in Damage Claims with its status and amounts only; Claim Chase List ranks the open claims and Claim Ageing shows how old they are.
Run Repeat-Damage Finder and Deposit Size Test every quarter to see which segment needs a larger deposit.
Enter every toll and ticket in Tolls and Tickets; Toll Match names the rental that had the car and the amount to pass on.
Check Renter Status before a pickup: documents checked, age band and status give a go, hold or no-go.
Use Photos and Keys and Photo Discipline Score to keep your handover habits steady.
A one-car host uses the same sheets with one vehicle and one channel.
Replace the demo rows with your own: delete the sample rows and keep the formulas, the sheets work with no macros in Excel and Google Sheets.
Use the 18 calculators, print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Handover and Fees Dashboard and the Charts every week: fees due, collected and left unbilled, claims, tolls and photo checks.

listing.title: Car Rental Handover, Return, Fees and Damage Excel Template: Check-out and Check-in, Late Fees, Claims, Tolls and Deposits
listing.headline: Every handover, return fee, damage claim and toll in one workbook
listing.description:
Run the moment a rental car changes hands, and the money that depends on it, in one Excel workbook. Built for the owner-operator of a small car or van rental or a car-sharing host and the manager, a detailer or a delivery driver who hands cars over and takes them back. Check-out and Check-in logs time, odometer, fuel or charge level, photos taken yes or no and keys; miles driven, late minutes after your grace, refill steps and the fee due fill in by themselves (miles are the demo unit, set your own). Fee Log shows each fee billed, collected, written off or never billed, Fee Ageing shows what is open, and Money Left on the Table shows the fees you were owed and forgot to bill, month by month.

Damage Claims keeps each claim as a status and amounts only, with days open, net cost and a chase action; Claim Ageing and Claims by Month show how old the claims are, and Damage by Segment ranks classes, channels, plans, young drivers and cover options by damage cost per rental. Tolls and Tickets and Toll Match find the rental that had the car on the date and show the amount to pass on with your admin fee. Renter Status gives a go, hold or no-go verdict from status and documents checked. No addresses, licence or card numbers are kept.

18 decision tools answer weekly questions: which fees are due on this return, how much money was left on the table, which claim to chase first, which segment needs a larger deposit, does the deposit of a class cover the damage, and whether to pass on a toll. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to renters, a hotel partner, marketplace support, your team and your advisers.

This is part three of the Car Rental Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no per-vehicle fee, with a demo copy full of sample data. It helps you keep track of your fees and claims and does not promise results. Check your local rules and your insurance terms.
